item.title: Non residential wastewater
item.description:
One of the biggest opportunities for reducing the environmental footprint of primary industry exists in the handling and reduction of wastewater.

The headline example of this at the moment is probably AI datacenters; the media are describing an AI landscape where every model interaction supposedly requires a vast amount of water and electricity to cool these vast computer hubs. Water is not actually consumed in this process; however, it is considered waste because it is a vector transporter of heat, where heat is the waste product.
